author: Nick Crowley
description:
In August 2011, videos appeared on YouTube promoting a new company called “Aviloop”. But despite posing as a normal aviation business, these commercials proved so unsettling that many suspected something sinister was happening behind the scenes. And these theories would only be heightened following the disturbing revelation of its creator's identity.

This is the depraved rabbit hole of Aviloop. An enduring internet mystery. 

Thanks to Jessicur for helping research! - https://www.youtube.com/@jessicur
